'''Hol Kinto''' was the fifth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Nagi system/Legends|Nagi system]]. It was located in a dense [[Unidentified star cluster|star cluster]] within the satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[Firefist|Companion Besh]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] classified as part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] that had five [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nagi Prime]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hol Kinto was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
